title: 挖掘机的一天
subtitle: 栏杆里面，在造什么呢？
character: wearing a red t-shirt, denim overalls and brown boots, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in vintage mid-century style, cute simple rounded machines with friendly toy-like shapes, thick black outlines, flat bright colors of mustard yellow, orange, teal and black, halftone dot texture on off-white paper, clean simple background, every person has natural skin tones
facts: 用长长的手臂和铲斗挖土
把土运走，车斗一抬就倒下
把很重的东西吊到高处

pages.zh:
我家旁边，围起了一圈高高的栏杆。
栏杆里面，轰隆隆，轰隆隆，好热闹。
妈妈说，那是工地，很危险，小朋友不能进去。
我就站在栏杆外面，从缝里往里看，
好多大机器正在忙着呢！
pages.scene: The little boy stands outside a tall construction site fence, looking through a gap in the fence at big yellow machines working on the dirt inside, safe on the sidewalk.

pages.zh:
最显眼的是大「挖掘机」，
它伸出长长的手臂，手臂的尽头是一只大铲斗，
铲斗上还有一排尖尖的牙齿。
它往下一挖，就是一大块土。
司机叔叔坐在驾驶室里，轻轻一拉，手臂就动了。
pages.scene: A big simple cartoon excavator with chunky rounded shapes, a grown-up driver with a bushy mustache in a yellow hard hat sitting inside its cab, digs into a pile of brown earth with its long arm, its toothed bucket full of dirt, a construction site with a fence and a crane in the distance.

pages.zh:
挖出来的土，要运到别的地方去。
大大的自卸车开过来，
挖掘机把土一斗一斗地倒进车斗里。
自卸车开到另一边，车斗慢慢抬起来——
哗！土就全倒下来了。
pages.scene: A big simple cartoon dump truck with chunky rounded shapes, a grown-up driver with a bushy mustache in a yellow hard hat sitting inside its cab, tips up its raised orange bed, and a pile of brown dirt slides out onto the ground at the construction site.

pages.zh:
推土机来了，
它的前面有一块又宽又平的大铲子。
它往前推呀推，
把高高低低的土堆，推得平平整整，
像在给大地铺一张新床单。
pages.scene: A simple cartoon bulldozer with chunky rounded shapes, a grown-up driver with a bushy mustache in a yellow hard hat sitting inside its cab, pushes a mound of dirt forward with its wide flat blade, leaving flat smooth ground behind it.

pages.zh:
水泥搅拌车的大肚子，一直在转呀转。
里面装着灰灰的、湿湿的水泥，
要是停下来不转，水泥就会慢慢变硬。
到了地方，水泥顺着长长的滑槽流出来，
以后会变成结实的房子和路。
pages.scene: A simple cartoon cement mixer truck with chunky rounded shapes, a grown-up driver with a bushy mustache in a yellow hard hat sitting inside its cab, its big striped drum turning, pours grey wet concrete down a chute at the construction site.

pages.zh:
工地中间，站着高高的塔吊，
它比楼房还要高，像一个长胳膊的巨人。
操作员叔叔坐在高高的小房子里，
塔吊把一捆长长的钢筋吊起来，
一下子送到了半空中。
pages.scene: A tall simple cartoon tower crane with chunky shapes stands in the middle of the construction site, a grown-up operator with a bushy mustache in a yellow hard hat in its small cab high up, lifting a bundle of long steel beams into the blue sky on its cable.

pages.zh:
工人叔叔都戴着黄色的安全帽，穿着橙色的背心，
这样大家远远就能看见他们。
他们围在一起看图纸，
一边看，一边商量，
告诉每一辆车该做什么。
pages.scene: Construction workers in yellow hard hats and orange vests stand together at the site, one of them pointing at a big rolled-out plan, simple cartoon machines behind them.

pages.zh:
最后，压路机慢慢地开过来，
它有一个又大又重的圆滚轮，
轰隆隆地压过新铺的路面，
把路压得又平又光，
走在上面，一点也不颠。
pages.scene: A simple cartoon road roller with chunky rounded shapes, a grown-up driver with a bushy mustache in a yellow hard hat sitting inside its cab, slowly rolls its big smooth drum over a freshly paved dark path, making it flat and shiny.

pages.zh:
过了好多好多天，高高的栏杆终于拆掉了。
我跑过去一看——
原来他们造的是一个新的游乐场！
有滑梯，有秋千，还有一个大大的沙坑。
我一边跑一边笑，第一个冲了进去。
pages.scene: The fence is gone and a brand new playground stands where the construction site was, with a slide, swings and a sandbox. The little boy runs toward it happily.

pages.zh:
我坐在沙坑里，开着我的小挖掘机，
挖一挖，推一推，堆起一座小土山，
我也在造房子呢。
长大以后，我也想开真的大机器，
给小朋友们造更多好玩的地方！
pages.scene: The little boy kneels in a sandbox playing with a toy yellow excavator, digging a small hole and building a little mound of sand, sunny playground around him.
